items.title: Gran Alegria at Hanshin
items.text: Run at Hanshin while Kyoto was rebuilt. Gran Alegria won as favourite in 1:32.0, three-quarters of a length ahead of Indy Champ.

items.title: Gran Alegria again
items.text: At Hanshin again. Gran Alegria won it a second year in a row, as favourite, three-quarters of a length ahead of Schnell Meister.

items.title: Serifos at 6th favourite
items.text: Serifos, sixth favourite, won at Hanshin in 1:32.5, 1¼ lengths clear of Danon the Kid. Sodashi was third.

items.title: Back at Kyoto
items.text: The race returned to the rebuilt Kyoto. Namur, fifth favourite, held off Soul Rush by a neck in 1:32.5.

items.title: Soul Rush's turn
items.text: Second the year before, Soul Rush won at fourth favourite in 1:32.0, 2½ lengths clear of Elton Barows.

items.title: Jantar Mantar's race record
items.text: Jantar Mantar won as favourite in 1:31.3, the race record and level with the course record, 1¾ lengths ahead of Gaia Force. Water Licht was third at 15th favourite.
